chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch 383: Starfall Sea's Beast Core Economy & A Deadly Proposition
chapter_meta_description: Han Li discovers the Starfall Sea's alchemy runs on demonic beast cores, not herbs. Meanwhile, a suspiciously generous merchant guild proposes a life-or-death hunting mission.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey: The Hunting Grounds of the Starfall Sea
og_description: Preparation is a battle of its own. Han Li navigates a suspicious gift, a dangerous job offer, and a paradigm-shattering discovery about the local pill economy.
twitter_title: No Free Lunches in the Starfall Sea
twitter_description: Han Li turns down a dangerous escort mission and stumbles upon the Starfall Sea's dark secret: cultivators here hunt beasts, not herbs.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-tier monster within the Starfall Sea's ecosystem, whose power exceeds that of most Foundation Establishment cultivators and requires organized teams to subdue.
A legendary pill that purportedly aids cultivators at the Half-Foundation stage in breaking through to Core Formation.
A specialized defensive array used to contain powerful aquatic demonic beasts, requiring six skilled cultivators to operate as nodes.
An ancient formula used to promote the rank advancement of spirit beasts over time.
The stage where a cultivator compresses their internalized spiritual energy into a solid, potent golden core within their dantian.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't Han Li just accept the gift?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the Mortal Stream, an unsolicited gift is a debt and a leash. Han Li knows that free offers always come with strings attached, so he preemptively refuses to maintain leverage.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is a sixth-rank demonic beast really that dangerous?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Absolutely. Han Li nearly died fighting a fourth-rank beast, and each rank represents an exponential power jump. A sixth-rank beast is a regional catastrophe, requiring Core Formation cultivators and grand formations to subdue.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the beast core economy important?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a fundamental paradigm shift. In the Heavenly South, power came from farming rare herbs. On the Starfall Sea, power comes from hunting monsters. This changes Han Li’s entire long-term resource strategy.
